findings.statement: Webhook delivery for event payment.captured failed with HTTP 500 after 3 attempts.
Order status transitioned to FAILED due to no payment confirmation within 15 minutes, despite gateway status being CAPTURED.

data.narrative: The payment was captured at the gateway (ev_03), but webhook delivery for event payment.captured failed with HTTP 500 after 3 attempts (ev_04, fd_01). Due to missing payment confirmation within 15 minutes, the order status diverged and transitioned to FAILED (ev_02, ev_10, fd_02).

data.narrative: The payment was successfully captured at the gateway (ev_02), but the payment.captured webhook failed with HTTP 500 after 3 attempts (ev_04). This webhook processing failure prevented status synchronization, causing the internal order state to diverge to FAILED due to unconfirmed payment (ev_03, ev_10).
